      public Game(Player user, User userProfile, int userBalance, int numPlayers, int initBlind, int whenIncreaseBlinds, int gameLength, Difficulty difficulty)
      Constructor called when starting a new game of poker
      Parameters:
      user - : The users player data
      userProfile - : users profile in database.
      numPlayers - : number of total players,
      initBlind - : the starting size of the blinds
      whenIncreaseBlinds - : How many rounds need to be played before the blinds increase
      gameLength - : maximum number of rounds the poker game goes for.
      difficulty - : affects the intelligence, risk taking and starting cash of the AI players

    • init

      public void init()
      Initialises the game by creating AI players, assigning roles, and opening a database session. Also checks whether the blind should be increased before the first round.

    • start

      public void start()
      Sets the game status to RUNNING and starts the first round.

    • startNextRound

      public void startNextRound()
      Starts the next round if the game is running and the end conditions have not been met. Guards against concurrent round starts using a synchronized flag. End conditions include: user balance = 0, no rounds left, or only user remains.

    • onRoundEnded

      public void onRoundEnded()
      Called when the current round has finished. Logs the round, rotates roles, decrements the round counter, and begins the next round.

    • end

      public void end()
      Ends the game by persisting the session to the database.

    • closeSession

      public void closeSession()
      Closes the game session safely from any thread (e.g. when the window is closed mid-game). Idempotent — calling this more than once has no additional effect.

    • checkForfeitedPlayers

      public void checkForfeitedPlayers()
      Checks for players whose action is FORFEIT and removes them from the active player list. Updates the total player count accordingly.

    • tryIncreaseBlind

      public void tryIncreaseBlind()
      Doubles the blind size if the required number of rounds since the last increase have elapsed. Has no effect on the very first round or if the increase interval has not been reached.
